statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6638 (REFRESH PUBLICATION allows SQL injection via table name) in 16.14 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6638/ lists 16.14 as the fixed release for major version 16 (minor versions before 16.14 are affected; versions before 16 are not), and the 16.14 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.14/, list it under 'Properly quote object names in logical replication origin checks'. The fix is https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/248a433cd10759ef968ebed655d19dd1ef129bf6 (Fix SQL injection in logical replication origin checks, tagged Security: CVE-2026-6638), in the REL_16_14 release tag and not in REL_16_13. In check_publications_origin() in src/backend/commands/subscriptioncmds.c it passes the subscriber's schema and table names through quote_literal_cstr() instead of interpolating them between bare single quotes in the query sent to the publisher. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; its 16.14-r0 security upgrade, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/commit/56de254843f841a99aedea4953a2dc9ec9338eb4, lists CVE-2026-6638 under the 16.14-r0 secfixes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres in the postgresql16 package, in every postgresql16 build published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI package repository as of 2026-11-27 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64, with package checksums verified against the package index. 16.13-r0 reports PostgreSQL 16.13 and still holds the unquoted query fragment 'AND NOT (N.nspname = '%s' AND C.relname = '%s')' on both architectures; 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 report 16.14, 16.15 and 16.16, no longer hold that fragment, and hold the fixed form 'AND NOT (N.nspname = %s AND C.relname = %s)' on both architectures. 16.14-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix, and 16.13-r0 is affected.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6638 (REFRESH PUBLICATION allows SQL injection via table name) in 17.10 on the PostgreSQL 17 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6638/ lists 17.10 as the fixed release for major version 17 (minor versions before 17.10 are affected; the component is the core server), and the 17.10 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.10/, list it as 'Properly quote object names in logical replication origin checks'. The 17.x fix is https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/f0f59b658ef10901c9af3af7705c802a72a0577e ('Fix SQL injection in logical replication origin checks', tagged Security: CVE-2026-6638), which is in the REL_17_10 release tag and not in REL_17_9. In check_publications_origin() in src/backend/commands/subscriptioncmds.c it stops pasting the subscriber's schema and table names between single quotes into the query sent to the publisher, changing the format string "AND NOT (N.nspname = '%s' AND C.relname = '%s')" to "AND NOT (N.nspname = %s AND C.relname = %s)" and passing the names through quote_literal_cstr(). We checked the server program, /usr/libexec/postgresql17/postgres, in every postgresql17 package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI package repository as of 2026-11-28 (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64, with each package checked against the package index checksum. In 17.7-r0, 17.8-r0 and 17.9-r0 the program holds the old quoted format string once and not the new one; in 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0 it holds the new format string once and not the old one. The query text that precedes it in the same function ('SELECT DISTINCT P.pubname AS pubname') is present once in every build as a control, and the programs report PostgreSQL 17.7 through 17.12 respectively. 17.10-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix, and 17.7-r0 through 17.9-r0 are affected.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6638 (PostgreSQL REFRESH PUBLICATION allows SQL injection via table name) in 18.4 on the PostgreSQL 18 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6638/ lists 18.4 as the fixed release for major version 18 (minor versions before 18.4 are affected), and the 18.4 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.4/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/cb35d730689546dd7334437f2954a6670fbb967e on the REL_18_STABLE branch, which changes check_publications_origin() in src/backend/commands/subscriptioncmds.c (plus a test): the subscriber's schema and table names are now passed through quote_literal_cstr() before they are interpolated into the query sent to the publisher, instead of being wrapped in bare single quotes; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-6638 and is in the REL_18_4 release tag and not in REL_18_3. This code is compiled into the PostgreSQL server program, which ships in the postgresql18 package as /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres; the postgresql18-jit package carries the same source file's LLVM bitcode (postgres/commands/subscriptioncmds.bc) for JIT inlining. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball and lists CVE-2026-6638 under its 18.4-r0 secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD. We checked the server binary and the bitcode in every postgresql18 build published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI package repository as of 2026-11-28 (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0; there is no 18.5 build), on both x86_64 and aarch64, with package checksums verified against the package index: 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0 and 18.3-r0 report PostgreSQL 18.1, 18.2 and 18.3 and are affected, while 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0 report 18.4, 18.6 and 18.7 and carry the fix. As a check, the server binary in 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0 and 18.3-r0 contains the unquoted query fragment the fix removes, AND NOT (N.nspname = '%s' AND C.relname = '%s'), once and not the fixed fragment, while 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0 contain the fixed fragment, AND NOT (N.nspname = %s AND C.relname = %s), once and not the old one, on both architectures; subscriptioncmds.bc references quote_literal_cstr from 18.4-r0 on and not before. 18.4-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.
